presets.eth_blockNumber: Returns the latest synced block number (hex).
presets.eth_syncing: Returns sync progress object or false if synced.
presets.eth_gasPrice: Returns the current gas price in wei (hex).
presets.eth_getBlockByNumber: Fetches block details by number or tag ('latest').
presets.eth_getBalance: Returns the ROGUE balance (wei) of an address.
presets.eth_getTransactionByHash: Returns transaction details by tx hash.
presets.eth_getTransactionReceipt: Returns the receipt and logs of a mined tx.
presets.web3_clientVersion: Returns the current core-rogue client version.
presets.net_peerCount: Returns the number of connected P2P peers (hex).
presets.net_listening: Returns true if node is listening for P2P connections.
presets.eth_mining: Returns true if the node is actively mining.
presets.eth_hashrate: Returns current mining hashrate in H/s (hex).
presets.txpool_status: Returns pending and queued transaction counts.
presets.txpool_content: Lists all pending and queued transactions in pool.
presets.admin_nodeInfo: Returns enode, ports, and protocol metadata.
presets.admin_peers: Lists all connected P2P peers and capabilities.
presets.debug_metrics: Returns internal node metrics (requires debug API).
